definitions.all_observable_risk: All current moving paired flights at unblocked/matched decisions with a complete next 10s; no learned-support filter.
definitions.original_common_scored: Dev only: same ArrivalPolicy.forecast support and analytic prediction as the original model_gate.py.
definitions.time_residual: First straight detector crossing 30m before stop line minus decision time minus remaining_m/posted_speed; current-straight and observed-final-straight only. Current-other to final-straight stays in lane-change counts, not timing residuals. Descriptive, not censor-adjusted.
definitions.early_late: Early <-1s, late >1s; inclusive +/-1s tolerance for 1s observation.
definitions.nearest: Among current-straight observations of each release, minimize (abs(analytic_eta_s-10),decision_time), without conditioning selection on future outcome.
definitions.speed: Past 10s mean position advance / posted speed from immediately preceding snapshot; absent observation remains missing, not zero.
definitions.weights: Nearest-ETA10 current-straight observation per release is the main timing description; repeated-snapshot summaries are sensitivity analyses. City predictive MAE also equally averages complete seeds. No formal inference or learned correction.
